summary.name: BetterCapture
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source screen recorder for macOS built with SwiftUI and ScreenCaptureKit, offering ProRes 4444, HEVC and H.264 encoding.
use_cases: Recording screen demos or tutorials on a Mac
Capturing system audio and microphone together
Recording with transparency via alpha channel
Replacing QuickTime for basic screen capture
summary.what_it_does: BetterCapture records the macOS screen with system audio and microphone audio captured simultaneously. It supports ProRes 4444, HEVC and H.264 codecs, and an alpha channel for transparency. Content filtering lets you exclude specific windows from a recording. It uses the native macOS Content Picker for selecting what to capture and lives in the menu bar. Recordings are stored locally, and the page states there is no tracking, analytics or account requirement.
caveats: macOS only; no Windows or Linux version mentioned
